description: This file contains unit tests for font-related features in the MigraDoc and PdfSharp libraries, specifically testing the handling of predefined fonts, error fonts, bullet list fonts, and behavior under different rendering environments (CORE, GDI, WPF). It uses the Xunit testing framework and includes helper methods to verify font usage in generated PDFs.

classes.name: PredefinedFontsTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple test methods verifying font handling in PDF rendering scenarios.

methods.name: Use_default_error_font
methods.description: Test that verifies the default error font is used and available during PDF rendering, depending on environment.

methods.name: Use_alternate_error_font
methods.description: Test that verifies an alternate error font is used when specified.

methods.name: Fail_with_missing_error_font
methods.description: Test that checks rendering fails if the specified error font is missing.

methods.name: Use_default_bullets_font
methods.description: Test that verifies the default bullets font is used during PDF creation with bullet lists.

methods.name: Use_alternate_bullets_font
methods.description: Test that verifies alternate fonts are used for bullet levels.

methods.name: Fail_with_missing_bullets_font
methods.description: Test that rendering fails if bullet fonts are missing.

methods.name: RenderDocumentShouldFail
methods.description: Helper method to verify that the document rendering throws an exception, indicating failure.

methods.name: RenderDocumentShouldSucceed
methods.description: Helper method to render and save the document, asserting success.

methods.name: CheckErrorFont
methods.description: Checks the font used for error messages in the generated PDF.

methods.name: CheckBulletFonts
methods.description: Verifies the fonts used for different levels of bullet lists in the generated PDF.

methods.name: CreateDocument
methods.description: Creates a minimalistic MigraDoc document with basic content.

methods.name: CreateDocumentWithErrorMessage
methods.description: Creates a document that includes an image that will generate an error message in the PDF rendering.

methods.name: CreateDocumentWithBulletList
methods.description: Creates a document with a nested bullet list to test font handling for list levels.
